name: Endurance Technologies Ltd
_note: Fact base for the Endurance Technologies initiation (consolidated, Rs crore unless stated). Only sources published on or before 30-Sep-2026. FY26 = year to Mar-2026; Q1FY27 = Apr-Jun 2026. Company 'total income' and 'EBITDA' INCLUDE other income (FY26 EBITDA Rs2,090 cr = Screener operating profit Rs1,966 cr + other income Rs124 cr).

ar26.what: Annual Report FY2025-26 (consolidated and standalone accounts, statutory reports)

q4fy25deck.what: Q4FY25 results presentation (FY24-FY25 entity split, FY25 customer shares)

profile.what: Pune/Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar-based maker of aluminium die-castings (incl. 2W alloy wheels), 2W suspension (front forks, shock absorbers), braking (disc brakes, ABS), transmission (clutches) and, newer, battery packs and battery-management electronics (Maxwell). 34 plants: India and Europe (Italy, Germany). Promoter: Anurang Jain and family (75.0%).
profile.products: Aluminium die-casting (incl. machining, forgings, 4W castings), suspension (inverted front forks, mono-shocks), braking (disc brakes, ABS, CBS, 3W and 4W foundation brakes), transmission (clutch assemblies, driveshafts), alloy wheels, aftermarket, battery packs (from Jun-2026), BMS/motor controllers (Maxwell), solar dampers and actuators (non-auto)

entityFY26.src: q1deck p22 (Q1FY26 Europe restated to Rs1,007 cr)

mixFY26.src: q4deck p24 (share of consolidated total income)

profile.standaloneMix: ~70% of standalone income from motorcycles; scooters 14.3% in Q1FY27 (below 10% a few years ago); 4W ~6% (Rs180 cr in Q1FY27); clutches 3.5% of India sales are the only ICE-only product (q1call).
profile.customersNote: Share of consolidated total income, FY25 and FY26 (q4deck p29; q4fy25deck p27). Bajaj Auto was 39.4% in FY24. Bajaj's own volume grew 11.6% in FY26 vs Endurance's sales to it +16.1%; HMSI 7.9% vs +16.9%; Royal Enfield 23.9% vs +32.7%; TVS 21.2% vs +29.1% (q4call).

shares.src: AR FY26 corporate governance report, distribution of shareholding at 31-Mar-2026

fy26.src: AR FY26 consolidated P&L, notes 19, 27, 26b, KAM; q4deck p26; q4call

stoferle.acquired: 2-Apr-2025, 60% for EUR37.74 mn (Rs350 cr cash; Rs246 cr deferred payable for the remaining 40% under put/call options, 8% a year Jun-2026 to 2030: floor EUR5.03 mn per tranche plus 4.5x normalised EBITDA above EUR17 mn)

ordersEurM.mercedesHybrid: 100% share of business from Jan-2027 (competitor bankrupt); ~EUR40 mn annual potential (MOSL)

europe.iceShareOfRevenue: ~30% now, falling to 25% by FY28 (q1deck p10)
europe.src: q4call; q1call; q1deck pp9-10, 20; AR FY26 note 26b

q1fy27.industry: India Q1FY27 sales (SIAM): 2W 7.18 mn (+23.6%; motorcycles +19.3%, scooters +32.7%), 3W 0.37 mn (+40%), 4W 1.79 mn (+22.7%). EU registrations +7.4% (ex-Chinese OEMs +3%); EU production -5%; BEV 21.9%, PHEV 10.1%, mild hybrid 36.1% of registrations.

guidance.margin: No numeric margin guidance. 'Definitely we see a better Q2 and Q3 for sure... it will be better than Q1' (MD, q1call): Q1 raw-material rates were on the Q4FY26 base; Q1-average rates apply from Q2; aluminium alloy (60% of purchases) softer by Rs12-17/kg; conversion-cost (gas, fuel, wage) claims being settled in Q2-Q3.
guidance.capex: India capex ~Rs800 cr in FY27, similar to FY26 (Rs828 cr standalone); >80% expansion and dies (q4call, q1call). Europe EUR45 mn in FY26; EUR3.6 mn in Q1FY27.
guidance.orders: India orders won since FY23 Rs5,270 cr (Rs4,241 cr new), excluding Bajaj and Maxwell, peaking by FY29; RFQs Rs4,526 cr; EV orders Rs1,806 cr incl. Bajaj (q1deck p7-8, q1call).
guidance.newPlants: Bidkin 2W alloy wheels (from Oct-2025; ~Rs600 cr a year at peak by Q3/Q4FY27); Shendra 4W/non-auto machined castings (SOP Sep-2026; >Rs200 cr in FY27; Rs513 cr peak in early FY29); battery packs (SOP Jun-2026 for Hero MotoCorp; Rs300-360 cr, up to Rs600 cr in FY28 per customer outlook; 4W packs Q4FY27, Rs62 cr capex); Chennai brakes (3 mn assemblies; SOP Q2-Q3FY27); ABS +9 lakh units (SOP Sep/Oct-2026); dual-channel ABS for Bajaj (Q2FY27); fifth forging press (Q3FY27); solar dampers and actuators Rs345 cr of orders (q4call, q1call).
guidance.fourWheeler: 4W share ~6% of India sales; 'our plan is to reach 10% soon' (q4call).
guidance.incentives: Maharashtra PSI-2019 entitlement raised from Rs600 cr to Rs858 cr, availed as state-GST refunds over ~7 years; Rs121 cr booked in FY26 revenue, Rs35 cr in Q1FY27 (q4call, q4deck, q1deck).
guidance.mna: 'In future you will see certain M&As happening both in the automotive as well as the non-automotive field' in Europe (q1call).

history: Began with two aluminium die-casting machines in Aurangabad (now Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar)
Entered 2W suspension, transmission and disc brakes (Paioli, Adler and Grimeca collaborations); aftermarket

Europe: acquired Amann Druckguss (Germany) and Fondalmec (Italy), the base of today's Endurance Overseas; casting plants in Pune and Chennai; KTM collaboration for inverted front forks and mono-shocks
Listed on NSE and BSE (first trade 21-Oct-2016)
Acquired 99% of Italian clutch maker Adler; plants in Kolar (Karnataka), Sanand and Halol (Gujarat), Pantnagar; Vallam casting plant (Tamil Nadu)
Acquired Maxwell Energy Systems (BMS; from 1-Jul-2022, 100% from May-2025) and Frenotecnica and New Fren (Italy, 2W brakes); SMT electronics line
Bought 60% of Stöferle (Germany, machined aluminium castings) on 2-Apr-2025 for EUR37.74 mn; Bidkin alloy-wheel plant (Oct-2025)
Battery-pack SOP for Hero MotoCorp (Jun-2026); Stöferle stake raised to 68% (Q1FY27, EUR6.24 mn); Veicoli Srl (Italy) divested
